per_seed_results.note: Metrics (9 per configuration, split and seed), paired differences of R@10 and Hit@10 with both bounds of the article-group interval, query counts, checksums of the per-query and ranking files and checkpoint fields (sha256, state_dict_sha256, kind, n_tensors, epoch, global step, selection value). Each of the 36 pretrained values is compared with all three files.

original_report.note: R@10 and Hit@10 per configuration and split: the pretrained value, the fine-tuned value and the gain of each seed with both bounds of its interval; mean, SD, minimum and maximum over the seeds of the fine-tuned value and of the gain. The values that are not exactly equal are means that differ in the last digits (largest_absolute_difference, in percentage points).
not_compared: gain_of_seed_average_ci95 of original_report has no counterpart in the portable report
original_report holds R@10 and Hit@10 only; the other metrics are compared with the per-seed results

release_results.note: The differing values are file paths. The values found only in the source are the paths and checksums of the validation rankings, which are not shipped for seed 42.

notes: Source paths are relative to the folder of the source experiment. In it, both configurations were trained with pmc_pair_retrieval.train and evaluated with pmc_pair_retrieval.evaluate for seeds 42, 43 and 44, with the split and the hard negatives shipped in data/. Every evaluation records 86893 images and the sha256 of image_pairs.json that the multiseed command expects.

Per-query files, rankings, run summaries, training histories, checkpoint sidecars and run configurations are byte copies of the experiment's files. The evaluation files were taken from reports/final/seed<N>/per_query/<configuration>/, the copies that the experiment's report step made of the evaluator's output in eval/seed<N>/<configuration>/; each is byte-identical to that output.
Only weights.file in copied evaluation summaries was changed from an absolute path to a package-relative path. Checkpoint files for seeds 43 and 44 are not bundled.

The four seed configurations under configs/multiseed/ are the files that the runs of seeds 43 and 44 read from the experiment's package copy, with comment lines corrected after the runs (changed_comment_lines); their parsed content is unchanged. differences_from_experiment_inputs gives the old and the new text of every such line, also for the other files of INPUT_MANIFEST.json that differ from the experiment's package copy.

original_plan is null: the source experiment has no dated plan of its own. PLAN.md in this folder is the dated plan of the earlier three-seed experiment. It is retained unchanged as historical provenance, not as evidence of public preregistration; the runs recorded here were made later.

historical_check_counts, historical_agreement_with_release and historical_informational_failures are null: the analysis of the source experiment (original_analysis) counts no checks, has no informational checks and does not compare the values of its arm "resplit" with results/results.json of this release; it compares its arms with one another, among them the arm "resplit" with the published run of the earlier release (arm "published"). Its report (original_report) has empty lists under missing, problems and warnings, and records for each of the 12 fine-tuned evaluations of its arm "resplit" that the checkpoint file of the run folder has the sha256 recorded by the evaluator.
original_report covers four arms. The records in this folder belong to its arm "resplit" (updated pairs, recomputed split, hard negatives mined again, retrained).

The report step of the source experiment (original_report_step) wrote one results file per seed with pmc_pair_retrieval.compare and then ran original_analysis. portable_report_agreement compares the report of the multiseed command with these files and with original_report.

Seed 42 was trained and evaluated in the source experiment like seeds 43 and 44. Its evaluation files and checkpoint sidecars are shipped outside this folder, under results/ and weights/; its run records are not bundled. seed42_records gives the source of each.
Fresh report regeneration verifies the bundled records, not the absent checkpoint bytes.

differences_from_experiment_inputs.description: Files listed in INPUT_MANIFEST.json that differ from the file of the same path in the package copy that ran the source experiment. The run and evaluation records are listed under copied_files instead. A change of kind "expected value" replaces a constant that a check compares with or a message prints; a change of kind "comment or docstring" changes no code. Lines are numbered from 1; source_lines are the lines of the experiment's file, lines those of the file shipped here.
